notes: Intrepid Potash Inc. (NYSE: IPI). Only US producer of muriate of potash (KCl) — solar-evaporation operations in Carlsbad NM (HB & East), Moab UT, Wendover UT — plus the Trio (langbeinite, K-Mg-S) byproduct. Also growing oilfield products (water/brine sales to Permian) and Trio specialty business. Fiscal year ends Dec 31. Data from SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts and direct 10-K extraction (CIK 0001421461). Revenue tag changed FY23+ from RevenueMineralSales to RevenueFromContractWithCustomerIncludingAssessedTax; FY19-22 figures pulled from 10-K consolidated statements of operations (Mineral Sales segment line). EBITDA = operating income + D&A. Note: Aug 2020 1-for-10 reverse stock split — historical share counts pre-2021 restated by 10×. FY21 net income $249.8M / EPS $19.07 inflated by $208.9M deferred-tax-asset valuation allowance reversal; FY22 strong on Russia/Ukraine fertilizer-price spike. FY23-24 saw potash price collapse (~70% peak-to-trough) and FY24 net loss includes $172M asset-impairment charges on potash facilities and ~$40M deferred tax valuation allowance.

periods.notes: FY21: revenue $270.3M (+37% YoY) on potash price recovery. Op income $32.3M + D&A $36.0M = EBITDA $68.2M. Net income $249.8M / EPS $19.07 inflated by $208.9M deferred-tax valuation-allowance release. Debt-free year-end (paid off $10M); cash $36.5M (net cash position).

FY22: peak revenue $337.6M (+25%) on Russia/Ukraine potash-price spike (KCl spot >$1,000/t). Op income $95.4M + D&A $35.0M = EBITDA $130.5M. Net income $72.2M, EPS $5.49. Debt-free; ~$73M share buybacks reduced share count.

FY23: revenue −17% to $279.1M as potash prices collapsed. Op loss −$44.0M, D&A $39.4M, EBITDA −$4.6M. Net loss −$35.7M, EPS −$2.80. Cash drawdown to $4.1M (heavy capex on HB Solar Solution Mine restoration).

FY24: revenue $254.7M (−9%). Op loss −$19.9M, D&A $37.7M = EBITDA $17.8M (positive vs FY23). Net loss −$212.8M / EPS −$16.53 driven by ~$172M non-cash potash long-lived-asset impairment + ~$40M deferred-tax valuation allowance reinstatement. Cash recovery to $41.3M (Trio + oilfield free cash).

FY25: revenue $298.3M (+17% YoY). Op income $10.7M + D&A $40.6M = EBITDA $51.2M. Net income $11.2M, EPS $0.86 — return to profitability after FY23-24 trough. Debt-free with $83.5M cash (net cash $83.5M). Trio premium pricing + oilfield-water sales to Permian operators a tailwind.
